prompt: A finished folded off-white paper boat sailing steadily with a small triangular pennant at the top of its mast, a slender lighthouse on a small bare rock in the distance sending a beam of fine radiating lines across the water. Wide scene of the open sea seen from slightly above, a soft distant horizon, in a richly detailed engraved nautical chart style like a fine antique sea chart printed in two inks: the sea built from many layers of fine wave lines and hatching, line density increasing towards the deep water to give depth, tonal bands from deep cerulean at the bottom to lighter cerulean at the top, a delicate compass rose with fine tick marks in the top-right corner. Crisp sharp lines of several weights, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. No photographic rendering, no glow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no plants, no seaweed, no islands, full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame, the subject in the left half, open water on the right. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd and ink grey #13212b.
